---

## 1. `src/pages/SystemSettings.tsx` (874 lines)

A full-featured settings management page with:
- **Setting catalog** — ~80 settings organized into groups (AI/Claude, Voyage AI, Git platforms, JIRA, Confluence, Notifications, Agent Behaviour, Schedulers, Linter/SAST, PR Review, Security)
- **Tab system** — 5 tabs: AI & Models, Source Control, Integrations, Agent, Security
- **Accordion sections** — collapsible groups per tab
- **Row types** — `BooleanSettingRow` (toggle pill) and `EditableSettingRow` (text/number/select/textarea/secret with inline edit)
- **Search** — cross-group live filter
- **API** — `useQuery` to fetch `/settings`, `useMutation` for PUT `/settings/{key}` and DELETE `/settings/{key}`
- **Toast notifications** — success/error toasts auto-dismiss after 3.5s

---

## 2. `src/config/applicationMenu.tsx` (146 lines)

Defines the navigation menu items returned by `ApplicationMenuItems()`. Structure:
- **Dashboard** → `/`
- **Jobs** → `/jobs`
- **Plans** → `/plans`
- **Metrics** (parent, expandable) → Quality Reports `/metrics/quality`, Review Metrics `/metrics/reviews`, AI Stats `/stats`
- **Settings** (parent, expandable) → Repositories, Hooks, Prompts, Memories, **System** `/settings/system`

Uses `NavigationMenuItem` interface supporting `item`,
